BL-935 — A vitest run under a live full-forge pack on macOS takes 3 forks sized off RAM alone - add a second, CPU-axis ceiling that cuts it to 1 without touching the memory budget
What it solves: Source intake: backlog/INTAKE-cap-vitest-to-1-core-on-full-forge-macos.md (drained 2026-08-19, archived on mint per the backlog-root drain rule). 1:1 - the intake produced this ticket and no other.
The intake left three questions explicitly unlocked for the specifier. All three were settled by prob…
Approval context: Two things want your sign-off; the rest is settled.
The override semantics. You asked for 1 core on full forge on mac, and that is scenario row 1. I additionally specced an explicit SWARMFORGE_VITEST_MAX_FORKS escape hatch, and had to choose what it means when it disagrees with the pack rule. I mad…
BL-935 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-935" (or "reject BL-935 <reason>") to act.
